hook: Status Trio merges Wi-Fi, battery and volume
hookText: Status Trio merges Wi-Fi, battery and volume

beats.say: Status Trio is a free, open-source macOS app inspired by the iPhone's combined status bar that folds Wi-Fi, battery and volume into one configurable icon for the menu bar or Dock; version 1.10.4 shipped Nov 22.
The status panel switches audio devices and shows top apps by CPU, GPU, memory and network use.
The repo has about 2,100 stars and is Apache-2.0 licensed; the post is in Chinese.
